description: Copy SOURCE to DEST or multiple SOURCE(s) to the existing

option.name: --backup
tip: make a backup of each existing destination file

option.name: --compare
tip: compare each pair of source and destination files, and in some cases, do not modify the destination at all

option.name: --context
tip: set security context of files and directories

option.name: --directory
tip: treat all arguments as directory names. create all components of the specified directories

option.name: --group
tip: set group ownership, instead of process's current group

option.name: --mode
tip: set permission mode (as in chmod), instead of rwxr-xr-x

option.name: --no-target-directory
tip: treat DEST as a normal file

option.name: --owner
tip: set ownership (super-user only)

option.name: --preserve-context
tip: preserve security context

option.name: --preserve-timestamps
tip: apply access/modification times of SOURCE files to corresponding destination files

option.name: --strip
tip: strip symbol tables

option.name: --strip-program
tip: program used to strip binaries

option.name: --suffix
tip: override the usual backup suffix

option.name: --target-directory
tip: move all SOURCE arguments into DIRECTORY

option.name: --unprivileged
tip: do not require elevated privileges to change the owner, the group, or the file flags of the destination

option.name: --verbose
tip: explain what is being done

option.name: --version
tip: Print version

option.name: -b
tip: like --backup but does not accept an argument

option.name: -c
tip: ignored

option.name: -D
tip: create all leading components of DEST except the last, then copy SOURCE to DEST

option.name: -Z
tip: set SELinux security context of destination file and each created directory to default type

global_option.name: --help
tip: Print help
